model_accuracy: All nine pages US Letter (612 x 792 points) with the Learning Made Simple brand header, teal branding, warm autumn colors, and one consistent turkey character on Pages 1, 2, 3, 5 and 8. Fully vector, no raster images. Page 1: turkey beside a board with 5 numbered writing rows. Page 2: cut-and-paste turkey, 7 large pieces (one-piece feather fan, head, body, two wings, two feet) with dashed cut outlines following each piece shape, WORK AREA and CUT-OUT AREA fully separated. Page 3: mostly uncolored turkey, 16 numbered sections, warm legend with color names. Page 4: six words traced on primary guidelines with circle-the-matching-picture. Page 5: 5 by 4 mixed grid of 20 pictures plus a picture-supported recording table. Page 6: AB, AAB and ABC feather patterns with a small color key. Page 7: four pumpkin-growing stages in scrambled order. Page 8: busy autumn I Spy scene with a find-and-count table.

pages_detail.activities: Draw or write 5 things the child is thankful for, one in each numbered space
answers: The child's own answers; drawing counts as a full answer
pages_detail.title: I Am Thankful For...

pages_detail.activities: Cut out the 7 pieces and glue them in the work area to build one turkey, copying the model
answers: 7 pieces: feather fan, head, body, two wings, two feet; the model picture shows where each piece goes
pages_detail.title: Build a Turkey

pages_detail.activities: Color each numbered section using the legend
answers: 1 brown: body and both wings (3 sections)
pages_detail.title: Turkey Color by Number

pages_detail.activities: Trace each word, then circle the picture that matches
answers: turkey, pumpkin, apple, leaf, corn, pie; the matching picture is the word itself
pages_detail.title: Thanksgiving Words: Trace and Match

pages_detail.activities: Count each kind of picture in the grid and write each total in the recording table
pages_detail.title: Count the Thanksgiving Pictures

pages_detail.activities: Color the white feathers to finish each repeating pattern
pages_detail.title: Finish the Feather Pattern

pages_detail.activities: Number the 4 pictures in growing order, 1 to 4
answers: In page order: sprout 2, pumpkin 4, seed 1, growing plant 3
Growing order: 1 seed, 2 sprout, 3 growing plant, 4 pumpkin
pages_detail.title: Pumpkin Growing Sequence

pages_detail.activities: Search the autumn scene, find each kind of object, and write how many there are
pages_detail.title: Thanksgiving I Spy
